fullDescription: A warm, tactile soft-elevated button system on a sandy base: terracotta and olive buttons built from layered shadows (not borders) that lift on hover, with every variant, size and state plus a token recipe, in Inter.

structured.summary: A warm, tactile BUTTON SYSTEM showcase page on a sandy off-white base (#efe7d8), framed as a single 'Soft & Elevated' specimen canvas. The whole personality is soft physical elevation built from layered shadows instead of borders: every button sits on a stack of inset highlight + soft drop shadows and rises 2px on hover. A blurred sticky nav (a terracotta gradient rounded-square logo tile with a ph:stack-fill icon, a 'TactileUI' wordmark with a terracotta 'UI', a 'BUTTON SYSTEM' pill, four anchor links, a ghost 'Docs' link, and a small terracotta 'Get the kit' button) sits over a full-bleed two-column hero. The hero left holds an eyebrow pill ('A button system that feels pressable'), a huge black headline 'Soft & Elevated. Buttons with weight.' (the second line in burnt terracotta #a8481f), a warm subhead, a terracotta 'Browse the system' + soft 'Copy the tokens' CTA pair, and a 4-item feature row (7 variants / 3 sizes / 5 states / Tactile tokens). The hero right is an elevated 'Specimen' card on warm paper (#f7f2e8) previewing the whole kit with a LIVE pill, all variants, sizes, states, a hint line, and four palette swatches. The body is a stack of warm-paper rounded showcase sections, each with a numbered terracotta-wash chip header: 01 Variants (eight cells: terracotta / olive / soft / terra-tonal / olive-tonal / outline / ghost / icon), 02 Sizes (sm/md/lg plus a second mixed row), 03 States (rest, hover-lift, focus-ring, loading, disabled, demoed across terracotta then soft/olive), and a two-column 04 Tokens row (a palette swatch list beside a dark ink card holding the elevation-recipe box-shadow code, then an assembled terracotta-wash CTA bar). It closes on a sandy footer with the brand cluster and a specimen caption. The whole canvas reflows cleanly to one column on mobile.

style.description: A warm, calm, tactile aesthetic where the personality is SOFT elevation, every button is a gently raised surface built from layered inset + drop shadows, never a hard border, and it lifts 2px on hover. The base is a sandy warm off-white #efe7d8 with surfaces on warm paper #f7f2e8 / #faf6ec and a sandy-deep footer #e6dcc7. Text is a warm near-black ink #2b251d with a softer body ink #544c40 and a muted ink #6e6453. The system runs on two earthy accents: a terracotta family (DEFAULT #c4633f, dark #a94f2f, light #d98a68, wash #f3ddd0; solids ship slightly darkened #b5532f->#a8481f so white labels clear WCAG 4.5:1) and an olive family (DEFAULT #6b7048, dark #565a37, light #8a8f63, wash #e3e4d4). Inter is the only typeface (Google Fonts weights 400-900): font-black (900) tracking-tight display headlines, font-extrabold (800) section titles and wordmark, and font-semibold (600) button labels with letter-spacing -0.01em. Buttons share one elevation language: rounded 10-14px corners and a layered box-shadow of an inset top highlight (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22) inset) over a tight contact shadow plus a soft spread shadow (e.g. 0 2px 4px + 0 8px 18px -6px in the variant's shadow tint), all on a springy transform+shadow transition (.18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)); hover lifts translateY(-2px) and deepens the shadow, :active drops back translateY(1px). Surfaces echo the same recipe: warm-paper cards with an inset white top highlight + a big soft drop shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(80,68,48,.4)) and rounded-3xl corners. The hero uses two soft radial color washes (terracotta-wash top-right + an olive-tinted wash top-left) over the sand base. Iconography is Iconify ph (phosphor) glyphs. Nothing is loud or hard-edged, the warmth, the earthy terracotta/olive duo, and the soft layered elevation carry the identity.
style.prompt: Build a warm, tactile, soft-elevated button system on a sandy base. Load Tailwind via CDN and Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400;500;600;700;800;900) as the only sans family. Set body background #efe7d8 and base text color ink #2b251d, antialiased. Define the palette in tailwind.config.theme.extend.colors: sand { DEFAULT #efe7d8, deep #e6dcc7, card #f7f2e8, paper #faf6ec }; terra { DEFAULT #c4633f, dark #a94f2f, light #d98a68, wash #f3ddd0 }; olive { DEFAULT #6b7048, dark #565a37, light #8a8f63, wash #e3e4d4 }; ink { DEFAULT #2b251d, soft #544c40, mute #6e6453 }. The core component is .btn: font-weight 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, border-radius 12px, line-height 1, inline-flex items-center justify-center gap .5rem, user-select none, transition transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), background-color .18s ease; .btn:active transform translateY(1px). Sizes: .btn-sm font-size 12.5px / padding 8px 14px / radius 10px; .btn-md font-size 14px / padding 11px 18px; .btn-lg font-size 15.5px / padding 14px 24px / radius 14px. The signature is the LAYERED soft shadow per variant (an inset top highlight + a tight contact shadow + a soft spread shadow), and hover always lifts translateY(-2px) and deepens the shadow. The whole point is soft elevation built from shadows, not borders, warm and calm. Surfaces use rounded-3xl warm-paper cards (#f7f2e8) with box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(80,68,48,.4) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55) border. The hero background is two soft radial washes over sand: radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 78% -10%, #f3ddd0 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(900px 480px at 8% 8%, #e6e7d6 0%, transparent 50%), #efe7d8. The sticky nav uses .nav-blur (backdrop-filter saturate(1.4) blur(10px)) over background rgba(239,231,216,.78) with a 1px rgba(80,68,48,.10) bottom border. Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) loaded from code.iconify.design. Keep typography Inter throughout, font-black tracking-tight headlines, font-extrabold section titles, font-semibold buttons. No em-dashes in any copy.

layout_and_structure.description: A single full-bleed specimen-style canvas, every centered block in a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 column. Top to bottom: a sticky blurred nav (h-16), a full-bleed two-column hero (lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_.95fr]) with the headline/CTA block on the left and an elevated 'Specimen' preview card on the right over a soft radial-wash sand background, a main stack of warm-paper rounded-3xl showcase sections spaced space-y-7 (01 Variants, 02 Sizes, 03 States, 04 Tokens), and a sandy full-bleed footer. The hero headline scales clamp(40px,7vw,68px); the hero grid stacks to one column below lg; the nav center links and 'Docs' link hide on small screens; the Variants grid is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg:grid-cols-4; the Sizes grid is sm:grid-cols-3; the States grid is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg:grid-cols-5; the Tokens row is md:grid-cols-2; the footer and the assembled CTA bar reflow row -> column on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with .nav-blur (backdrop-filter saturate(1.4) blur(10px)) over background rgba(239,231,216,.78) and a 1px rgba(80,68,48,.10) bottom border. Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 row, h-16, items-center justify-between: LEFT (gap-2.5) = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded (radius 10px) .btn-terra gradient tile with a white ph:stack-fill icon at 18px, a 17px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Tactile' with a terracotta 'UI' (#a8481f), then a hidden-below-sm rounded-full olive-wash pill (#e3e4d4 bg, #565a37 text) reading 'BUTTON SYSTEM' (10.5px font-bold); CENTER (hidden below md, gap-7, 13.5px font-medium text-ink-soft) = four anchors 'Variants / Sizes / States / Tokens' that hover to text-terra; RIGHT (gap-3) = a ghost small button 'Docs' (hidden on the smallest screens) and a small .btn-terra .btn-sm button 'Get the kit' with a leading ph:sparkle-fill icon.

A relative overflow-hidden full-bleed section whose background is two soft radial washes over sand: radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 78% -10%, #f3ddd0 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(900px 480px at 8% 8%, #e6e7d6 0%, transparent 50%), #efe7d8. Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pt-20 pb-14 grid lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_.95fr] gap-10 items-center. LEFT column: an eyebrow pill (inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1.5, background rgba(255,255,255,.5), 1px rgba(80,68,48,.12) border) with a terracotta ph:hand-tap-fill icon + 'A button system that feels pressable'; a font-black tracking-tight leading-[0.98] text-[clamp(40px,7vw,68px)] h1 reading 'Soft & Elevated.' with a second block line 'Buttons with weight.' in burnt terracotta #a8481f; a mt-5 max-w-xl 16.5px leading-relaxed text-ink-soft subhead about a warm tactile kit built on layered shadows not borders; a mt-8 flex-wrap gap-3 CTA pair, a .btn-terra .btn-lg 'Browse the system' (leading ph:squares-four-fill) and a .btn-soft .btn-lg 'Copy the tokens'; then a mt-8 flex gap-5 12.5px font-medium text-ink-mute feature row of four items, each an olive ph:check-circle-fill icon + label ('7 variants', '3 sizes', '5 states', 'Tactile tokens'). RIGHT column: the elevated Specimen card (see special components).

An elevated preview card: rounded-3xl p-7 on warm paper #f7f2e8 with box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8) inset, 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(80,68,48,.45), 0 2px 6px rgba(80,68,48,.10) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6) border. Header row (justify-between mb-5): an uppercase 'SPECIMEN' label-chip in text-ink-mute, and a 'LIVE' status (11px font-bold tracking-wide olive #6b7048) with a 2px olive dot. Body (space-y-4): row 1 = .btn-terra .btn-md 'Primary' (leading ph:download-simple-bold) + .btn-olive .btn-md 'Secondary' + .btn-soft .btn-md 'Soft'; row 2 = .btn-tonal 'Tonal' + .btn-outline 'Outline' + .btn-ghost 'Ghost'; row 3 (items-center pt-1) = .btn-terra .btn-sm 'Small' + .btn-terra .btn-lg 'Large' + a .btn-terra .btn-md .is-loading 'Loading' + a .btn-terra .btn-md .is-disabled 'Disabled'. Footer (mt-6 pt-5, 1px dashed rgba(80,68,48,.18) top border, justify-between): a 12px text-ink-mute line 'Hover any button and it rises.' and a row of four 30px .swatch tiles (terracotta gradient, olive gradient, sand #efe7d8, ink #2b251d).

A rounded-3xl p-7 -> sm:p-9 warm-paper card (id=variants) with the standard inset+soft-drop card shadow. Header row (gap-3 mb-1.5): a .num-chip reading '01' (terra-wash chip) beside a 22px font-extrabold tracking-tight 'Variants' title; then a 14px text-ink-soft line 'Seven roles, one shadow language. Solids carry the weight, washes and ghosts step back.' Body = a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 of EIGHT cells, each a flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl py-7 px-3 on a rgba(250,246,236,.6) fill with a faint 1px rgba(80,68,48,.06) border, holding a .btn-md sample above an uppercase label-chip caption: Primary (.btn-terra, 'Terracotta'), Secondary (.btn-olive, 'Olive'), Soft (.btn-soft, 'Raised paper'), Tonal (.btn-tonal, 'Terra wash'), Tonal (.btn-tonal-olive, 'Olive wash'), Outline (.btn-outline, 'Bordered'), Ghost (.btn-ghost, 'Text only'), and an Icon cell (a circular .btn-terra .btn-md with border-radius 999px / width 44px holding a single ph:plus-bold glyph, 'Icon').

A rounded-3xl p-7 -> sm:p-9 warm-paper card (id=sizes). Header: a .num-chip '02' + a 'Sizes' title, then a 14px text-ink-soft line 'A 3-step scale, padding and radius tuned together so the elevation reads consistent at every size.' Body row 1 = a grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of three flex-col items-center justify-end cells (rounded-2xl py-8 px-4 on rgba(250,246,236,.6)), each a .btn-terra button with a leading ph:lightning-fill above a label-chip: 'Small' (.btn-sm, 'SM · 12.5px'), 'Medium' (.btn-md, 'MD · 14px'), 'Large' (.btn-lg, 'LG · 15.5px'). Body row 2 = a mt-5 grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mixing variants/sizes: .btn-soft .btn-sm 'Soft SM' ('on neutral'), .btn-olive .btn-md 'Olive MD' ('on solid'), .btn-tonal .btn-lg 'Tonal LG' ('on wash').

A rounded-3xl p-7 -> sm:p-9 warm-paper card (id=states). Header: a .num-chip '03' + a 'States' title, then a 14px text-ink-soft line 'Default, hover-lift, focus-ring, loading, and disabled. The shadow does the talking.' Body row 1 = a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-3 -> lg:grid-cols-5 gap-5 of five .btn-terra .btn-md state cells (each rounded-2xl py-7 px-3 on rgba(250,246,236,.6), a button above a label-chip): Default ('Rest'), Hover (statically forced to the lifted look, transform translateY(-2px) + the deepened hover shadow, 'Lifted'), Focus (.is-focus ring, 'Ring'), Loading (.is-loading spinner, 'Busy'), Disabled (.is-disabled, 'Off'). Body row 2 = a mt-5 same-shape grid showing the matrix on soft + olive: .btn-soft Default ('Soft rest'), a forced-hover .btn-soft ('Soft lift'), .btn-soft .is-focus ('Soft ring'), .btn-soft .is-loading ('Soft busy'), and a .btn-olive .is-disabled ('Olive off').

A rounded-3xl p-7 -> sm:p-9 warm-paper card (id=tokens). Header: a .num-chip '04' + a 'Tokens' title, then a 14px text-ink-soft line 'The deliberate palette and the layered-shadow recipe that ties the whole system together.' Body = a grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6: LEFT a 'Palette' panel (rounded-2xl p-6 on rgba(250,246,236,.7)) with an uppercase label-chip 'Palette' over a space-y-3 list of four rows, each a 30px .swatch + a 13px font-semibold name + a 12px font-mono hex: Warm sand #efe7d8, Terracotta #c4633f, Olive #6b7048, Warm ink #2b251d. RIGHT an 'Elevation recipe' panel (rounded-2xl p-6 on dark ink #2b251d) with a label-chip 'Elevation recipe' in #c79a82 over a syntax-highlighted <pre> font-mono code block (text #efe7d8) showing the layered box-shadow recipe (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.30) inset, 0 2px 4px rgba(120,52,28,.20), 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(120,52,28,.40)) plus 'hover: lift -2px, deepen', 'transform translateY(-2px)', 'radius 10-14px · font Inter 600', with terracotta-light (#d98a68) property names and olive-light (#a3a87a) values. Below the grid = a mt-6 assembled CTA bar (rounded-2xl p-6, flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between, background linear-gradient(180deg,#f3ddd0,#efe7d8), 1px rgba(196,99,63,.18) border): a left text block ('Ship the warm button system.' bold 15px + 'Drop-in CSS, tactile by default.' 13px text-ink-soft) and a right gap-3 button pair (.btn-ghost 'Preview' + .btn-terra 'Install' with a leading ph:download-simple-bold).

A full-bleed footer on sand-deep #e6dcc7 with a 1px rgba(80,68,48,.1) top border. Inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-8 flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4: LEFT a brand cluster (gap-2.5), a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-lg .btn-terra tile with a white ph:stack-fill icon, and a 13px font-semibold text-ink-soft line 'TactileUI Button System · a soft-elevated warm kit'; RIGHT a 12px text-[#5f5646] caption 'Specimen page · variants · sizes · states · tokens'.

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature component, a button whose entire identity is soft layered elevation, never a hard border. .btn = font-weight 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, border-radius 12px, line-height 1, display inline-flex, items-center justify-center, gap .5rem, user-select none, will-change transform, transition transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), background-color .18s ease. .btn:active transform translateY(1px). The depth always comes from a three-part box-shadow, an inset top highlight (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,...) inset), a tight contact shadow, and a soft spread shadow, tinted to the variant. Hover always lifts the button translateY(-2px) and deepens/spreads the shadow. Sizes scale padding/font/radius together: .btn-sm = 12.5px / 8px 14px / radius 10px; .btn-md = 14px / 11px 18px; .btn-lg = 15.5px / 14px 24px / radius 14px.

Each variant keeps the .btn shape and changes fill + shadow tint. .btn-terra: background linear-gradient(180deg,#b5532f,#a8481f) (darkened so white text clears 4.5:1), color #fff, box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22) inset, 0 2px 4px rgba(120,52,28,.22), 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(120,52,28,.42); hover translateY(-2px) + box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35) inset, 0 4px 8px rgba(120,52,28,.22), 0 16px 30px -8px rgba(120,52,28,.46). .btn-olive: background linear-gradient(180deg,#787c52,#6b7048), color #f4f3e6, same shadow recipe tinted rgba(54,57,33,...). .btn-soft: background linear-gradient(180deg,#fdfbf5,#f4eee1), color #2b251d, box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(80,68,48,.10), 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(80,68,48,.28) (a raised neutral paper). .btn-outline: background rgba(255,255,255,.35), color #8f3f23 (darkened for 4.5:1), 1.5px solid rgba(196,99,63,.5) border, box-shadow 0 4px 12px -8px rgba(120,52,28,.30); hover background #f3ddd0 + border rgba(196,99,63,.7). .btn-tonal: background #f3ddd0 (terra wash), color #8f3f23, box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(120,52,28,.30); hover background #eed0bf. .btn-tonal-olive: background #e3e4d4 (olive wash), color #565a37, olive-tinted version; hover background #d9dbc6. .btn-ghost: transparent, color #5a5246, no shadow, px-3; hover color #c4633f + background rgba(196,99,63,.08). All non-ghost hovers also lift translateY(-2px).

.is-loading: color transparent !important, pointer-events none, with a ::after spinner (15px circle, border 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5) with border-top-color #fff, border-radius 50%, animation spin .7s linear infinite; @keyframes spin to transform rotate(360deg)); on .btn-soft the spinner switches to a dark ink top (border-color rgba(80,68,48,.3), border-top-color #2b251d). .is-disabled: opacity .45, pointer-events none, filter grayscale(.25), box-shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(80,68,48,.12) !important, transform none !important (flat and dimmed). .is-focus: outline 3px solid rgba(196,99,63,.4), outline-offset 2px (a soft terracotta focus ring).

Every showcase section and the hero specimen is a warm-paper card: background #f7f2e8, rounded-3xl, border 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55-.6), with a layered shadow echoing the buttons, 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(80,68,48,.4) for body cards, and a deeper 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8) inset, 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(80,68,48,.45), 0 2px 6px rgba(80,68,48,.10) for the floating hero specimen. Inner sample cells use a quieter rgba(250,246,236,.6) fill with a faint 1px rgba(80,68,48,.06) border.

.num-chip = an inline-flex section-number chip, height 26px, min-width 26px, padding 0 7px, border-radius 8px, font-variant-numeric tabular-nums, font-weight 800, font-size 12.5px, color #8f3f23 on a #f3ddd0 terra-wash fill, with box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 4px 10px -6px rgba(120,52,28,.4). .label-chip = font-size 10.5px, font-weight 700, letter-spacing .08em, text-transform uppercase (the muted caption under every sample). .swatch = a 30px square, border-radius 9px, box-shadow 0 2px 8px -3px rgba(80,68,48,.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.5) inset (used for palette and the hero card swatch row).

The hero background layers two soft radial washes over the sand base: radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 78% -10%, #f3ddd0 0%, rgba(243,221,208,0) 55%) (a terracotta wash top-right) and radial-gradient(900px 480px at 8% 8%, #e6e7d6 0%, rgba(230,231,214,0) 50%) (an olive-tinted wash top-left), finished with #efe7d8. .nav-blur = backdrop-filter saturate(1.4) blur(10px), applied to the sticky header over background rgba(239,231,216,.78) so the sandy page frosts under it.

structured.special_notes: A warm, tactile, SOFT-ELEVATED button SYSTEM on a sandy base, the whole personality is soft layered-shadow elevation (never hard borders) plus a calm earthy terracotta + olive duo. Exact palette via Tailwind config: sand DEFAULT #efe7d8 / deep #e6dcc7 / card #f7f2e8 / paper #faf6ec; terra DEFAULT #c4633f / dark #a94f2f / light #d98a68 / wash #f3ddd0 (solids ship darkened #b5532f->#a8481f for WCAG 4.5:1 white text); olive DEFAULT #6b7048 / dark #565a37 / light #8a8f63 / wash #e3e4d4; ink DEFAULT #2b251d / soft #544c40 / mute #6e6453. The headline second line + wordmark accent use #a8481f; outline/tonal text uses #8f3f23 for 4.5:1; footer caption #5f5646. The .btn core: font-weight 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, radius 12px, inline-flex gap .5rem, transition .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); :active translateY(1px); hover always translateY(-2px) + deepened shadow. Every variant shadow = an inset top highlight + a tight contact shadow + a soft spread shadow tinted to the variant (terra/olive tint rgba(120,52,28,...) / rgba(54,57,33,...); soft + cards tint rgba(80,68,48,...)). Variant fills: terra linear-gradient(180deg,#b5532f,#a8481f) white; olive linear-gradient(180deg,#787c52,#6b7048) #f4f3e6; soft linear-gradient(180deg,#fdfbf5,#f4eee1) #2b251d; outline rgba(255,255,255,.35) + 1.5px rgba(196,99,63,.5) border, #8f3f23 text, hover bg #f3ddd0; tonal #f3ddd0 #8f3f23 (hover #eed0bf); tonal-olive #e3e4d4 #565a37 (hover #d9dbc6); ghost transparent #5a5246 (hover #c4633f on rgba(196,99,63,.08)). Sizes scale padding+font+radius: sm 12.5px / 8px 14px / r10; md 14px / 11px 18px; lg 15.5px / 14px 24px / r14. States: .is-loading transparent label + a .7s spinner (white-top on solids, ink-top on .btn-soft); .is-disabled opacity .45 + grayscale(.25) + flat shadow + transform none; .is-focus a 3px rgba(196,99,63,.4) outline at offset 2px. Surfaces: warm-paper cards #f7f2e8 rounded-3xl, box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(80,68,48,.4) (hero specimen deeper: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(80,68,48,.45)); inner cells rgba(250,246,236,.6) + 1px rgba(80,68,48,.06). Accents: .num-chip terra-wash #f3ddd0 / #8f3f23 tabular-nums 800; .label-chip uppercase 10.5px 700 tracking .08em; .swatch 30px r9 with inset ring + soft drop. Hero bg = radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 78% -10%, #f3ddd0, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(900px 480px at 8% 8%, #e6e7d6, transparent 50%), #efe7d8; .nav-blur saturate(1.4) blur(10px) over rgba(239,231,216,.78). Font: Inter ONLY (Google Fonts 400-900), font-black tracking-tight headlines, font-extrabold (800) section titles + wordmark, font-semibold (600) buttons. Icons are Iconify ph (phosphor) from code.iconify.design (stack-fill, sparkle-fill, hand-tap-fill, squares-four-fill, check-circle-fill, download-simple-bold, lightning-fill, plus-bold). To transfer the STYLE keep the sandy warm base + warm-paper surfaces + the terracotta/olive earthy duo + Inter, and above all the SOFT layered-shadow elevation (inset highlight + contact + soft spread) with the gentle translateY(-2px) hover lift, no hard borders. To transfer the LAYOUT keep the single specimen canvas (sticky blurred nav -> two-column hero with a left headline/CTA block + a right elevated specimen card over a soft radial-wash sand background -> warm-paper showcase cards 01 Variants / 02 Sizes / 03 States / 04 Tokens, each with a numbered terra-wash chip header -> an assembled terracotta-wash CTA bar -> a sandy footer) and the 'button above an uppercase label-chip' demo grids. No em-dashes in any copy.
